title: Incredible day trip to Tangier!
text: Our day trip to Tangier on Friday, September 11th was fantastic! Communication with the staff to confirm pickup location was effortless.  The driver arrived on time and made sure we were comfortable for the ride to Tarifa.  We arrived at the port with plenty of time to spare, then boarded the 60 minute ferry to Tangier.  Upon arrival, we were quickly greeted by Samir who then introduced us to our driver, Mohammed. We spent the day in a very comfortable van exploring the city.
